From: Elena Gomez <elena@novix.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo this morning — join button missing and RSVP shows organizer-only

Hi Aisha / team,

Sorry to ping early — our team booted up for the 9:00 demo but the calendar entry in GSuite showed no Join button (GMail/GCal: the event appears but neither guests nor I can see the Meet/Zoom link). RSVP column also shows: "Only organizer can join" which is unexpected. I tried opening the .ics attached to re-add but the file looks like it was scrubbed of the URL.

Attaching the invite I received (novix-demo.ics) and a quick screenshot of the RSVP state (will send in a follow-up). Can you confirm whether this is an internal organizer/alias stripping issue on Redwood's side? We do have SSO and strict guest rules, but we've joined Redwood demos before without this behavior.

We had a few engineers and a product manager waiting; we jumped onto standby Zoom at our end but would prefer to use the scheduled link in calendar so our PM can click through from GCal.

Thanks — Elena

--
Elena Gomez
Head of Product, Novix
elena@novix.ai
novix.ai

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>

Cc: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:29:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo this morning — join button missing and RSVP shows organizer-only

Hi Elena — so sorry about the disruption and thanks for flagging.

We saw a spike in organizer-alias normalization this morning which in some cases strips the external join URL from the published .ics when the organizer is an alias that doesn't map cleanly to a Redwood service account. That would explain the "Only organizer can join" RSVP state you reported.

Immediate plan (short term):
- I just created a temporary Zoom meeting and pasted the alternative join link below so the teams can proceed now: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=temp-passcode (passcode: 6b7R)
- Ben (cc'd) has opened an internal incident so we can claim the organizer and re-issue a corrected .ics that retains the join URL. Ticket: INC-4923.
- We'll push a calendar reissue that preserves the original event time and guest list; when you accept the new invite the Join button should appear in GCal.

Longer term: our infra team is rolling a fix to the alias normalization flow to avoid stripping external join urls for scheduled demos. I'll follow up with an ETA by EOD.

Really sorry for the friction today. Please use the temp Zoom above; I'll update when the corrected .ics is out.

Best,
Aisha
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com
T: +1 415-555-0198
